notes.title: Heartbit Interactive is shutting down :(
notes.content:
Hello dudes and dudettes,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8133343/93487cbd1362544912585e7a646d411330b80f2f.jpg[/img]

Sorry for the radio silence, we had our reasons… and, well, they weren’t great.

[b]It’s with heavy heart-bits that we announce Heartbit Interactive is shutting down.[/b]

We can’t stress this enough: [b]we made it this far thanks to you[/b], our players, friends, supporters and colleagues! You’ve cheered us on with love and devotion (the Flying Spaghetti Monster is most pleased for that). Sadly, due to economic reasons, we’re no longer able to sustain the development of new games, and we’ve had to make the tough decision to close Heartbit Interactive.

But don’t worry, [b]this isn’t a game over[/b]. Our existing games will remain available, and we’ll continue supporting them and responding to your questions for as long as our aging bodies and frail memories allow.

You might notice different names listed as the publisher in some stores, Heartbit Games, Heartbit Interactive Games, Francesco Ficarelli, or Matteo Nicolotti, but it’s still us behind the curtain.

[b]Thank you for every download, every message, every laugh. It’s been an incredible journey.[/b]

With all our HP and MP,
[i]The Heartbit Team[/i]

notes.title: Super GIGA Discount to celebrate 11 years of Doom & Destiny
notes.content:
Hello dudes and dudettes,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8133343/053e95892822271e47989380faf29866c92720d4.jpg[/img]

we can't believe that (almost) 11 years ago we released Doom & Destiny ːfsmː
And it's even more incredible that after all that time, we are still here making game and making more Doom & Destiny ːMikeAdvː

We wanted to celebrate this huge achievement by launching a super-mega-giga discount, the biggest we ever did, to spread even more the nerdy humor of Do&De ːNigelAdvː

As a proof of our love and dedication to our games, we even updated Doom & Destiny. It's a technical update, but the new fixes should improve performance (especially audio related) on many new computers ːdarkeidː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/318130/Doom__Destiny/

We hope that the Flying Spaghetti Monster will bless us with endless energy, MP and treasures to continue developing games 'till the end of times ːfsmː

notes.title: Doom & Destiny and Doom & Destiny Advanced FREE Weekend!!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZSk-BWe1OH4;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't believe it, [b]but 10 years ago, on August 26, 2011, Doom & Destiny was released for the very first time[/b] on XBox 360 ːfsmː

This means two things: first, the we are getting OLD ːFrancisAdvː, second, that we wanted to celebrate with you that achievement ːPizzaAdvː

And what better way to celebrate than having a big-ass party with as many people as possible ːmybeerː ːmypizzaː ːmybeerː

That's why we want to let everyone enjoy for free, even if only for a weekend, [b]Doom & Destiny[/b] and [b]Doom & Destiny Advanced[/b] here on Steam!

It's thanks to you fans that we are still here today, after all this time ːMikeAdvː,
and we hope to be albe to do this 'till we run out of "extra life" ːdarkeidː ːdarkeidː ːdarkeidː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/318130/Doom__Destiny/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/361040/Doom__Destiny_Advanced/

But celebrations don't end here. Today marks another important achievement for us:
[b]Doom & Destiny WORLDS[/b], the third chapter of the Doom & Destiny series,
[b]is releasing on Nintendo Switch[/b] ːfsmː

[previewyoutube=E3lxTuf_o9A;full][/previewyoutube]

We are incredibly exited to have all our games on the Nintendo Switch, especially considering all the hard work we put into polishing the game for a console release.
Also, the Doom & Destiny series is a blast to be played on a handheld device and we can't wait to run it on the Steam Deck too ːNigelAdvː

#NerdsNeverDie they only get old ːdarkeidː
